items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I’ve gotten to play with some of the greatest man. I mean that CD we did together... Keter Betts

ctx.x: So there was some use in that thing there.

Some use there, just conduct yourself in a nice manner. But I’ve gotten to play with some of the greatest man. I mean that CD we did together, you had some of the greatest people on there — Bill Watrous, Jerome Richardson, Keter Betts, yourself.
